subject: Film & Cinema
title: Independent Cinema's Rise
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Independent Cinema's Rise.

hook.text: In 1994, a $8,000 film about petty criminals made $214 million worldwide.

buildup.text: Pulp Fiction and the Sundance generation proved audiences craved original voices.

discovery.text: Studios created indie divisions to capture this market without the risk.

twist.text: Most of those indie divisions were eventually shut down when profits disappointed.

climax.text: True independents now fund films through streaming deals and crowdfunding.

punchline.text: Independence means finding new ways to survive.

quiz.question: What 1994 film symbolized indie cinema's mainstream breakthrough?
